viator_experiences.description_md: Manchester is home to one of the UK's most thriving craft beer scenes, and on this insider tasting tour you discover some of the city's best breweries. A guide takes the guesswork out of choosing where to drink, leading you to a selection of hand-picked, locals-loved watering holes. Enjoy plenty of samples across a wide range of beer styles while learning about local beer history and the brewing process from your guide. All drinks are included in the price, and the sociable afternoon lasts around 3 hours 30 minutes.
